mapper.select: SELECT cd.id, cd.drawing_source, cd.product_category, cd.prod_name, cd.part_no, cd.customer_name, cd.dwg_file_id, cd.status, cd.create_time, cd.update_time, f.file_url as dwg_file_url, f.file_name as dwg_file_name FROM doc_countersign_drawing cd LEFT JOIN file_info f ON cd.dwg_file_id = f.id WHERE cd.id = #{id}
